pressure_calibrate_step1: Step1: under no pressure, 0 psi, press

ctl_pid_hint: PID control drives both the heater and the cooler toward the setpoint.
ctl_experimental_body: Ramp profile with Fridge control is in the testing phase. Perform your own tests and do not rely on it unattended.
ctl_standby_setpoint: Shows the current setpoint and follows it while a ramp is running.
ctl_standby_heat: Shows the current heating setpoint and follows it while a ramp is running.
ctl_slope_learner: Pulse PI on beer temperature (heater only)
ctl_predictive_body: Uses the heater only, and only in Independent mode. Kp and Ki turn the gap between the beer and its setpoint into a duty cycle, capped at 50 %, so the heater always rests at least as long as it heats. The duty is delivered as one pulse whose length is learned: after every pulse the heater stays off while the slow filter is watched for the peak, then the next pulse is rescaled so the beer rises about the number of sensor steps set below. Far below the setpoint a pulse stops early and lets the stored heat coast the beer up, and the heater is always cut at setpoint + 0.25 degC. A pulse never exceeds 300 s. The cooler is unchanged.
ctl_enter_og: Enter the original gravity, then start the profile.
ctl_preset_1: +1 °C per day for 3 days when gravity reaches 1.018
ctl_easy_note: After the ramp ends, the heating setpoint stays at the target temperature and the fixed setpoint is updated to it. You can switch back to Fixed temperature at any time.
ctl_replace_body: The current profile will be replaced by this easy ramp.
scale_help_zero: Leave the platform empty and select Zero; the controller averages 30 raw readings and does not wait for a perfectly still value. Place a known weight on the platform, enter its mass and calculate the factor the same way. Verify with a second known weight. Empty keg mass is separate from platform zero.
scale_help_limit: Zero and Calculate factor compare the average of the first 15 readings with the last 15. If they differ by more than this limit, the load changed during averaging and nothing is saved. Raise it if a still but noisy scale keeps failing; lower it to catch smaller changes. The daily measurement uses the same limit.
scale_history_note: One record per scale per day, from 50 readings. The bars are the beer that left every keg that day, added together. Each keg has one line for the beer left (L). Click a legend item to show or hide that line. The chart shows all kegs, so the keg selector above does not change it. K marks a keg change, U a measurement where the load changed.
scale_correction_help: t = °C, result in raw counts. Paste the formula y2tlogviewer copies.
scale_err_limit: Enter a limit between 1 and 8388607 raw counts.
scale_err_empty_mass: Empty keg mass must be zero or more.
scale_err_capacity: Capacity must be at least 1 litre.
scale_err_density: Beer density must be between 0.8 and 1.3 kg/L.
scale_err_sample_interval: Enter a sampling interval between 1 and 120 minutes.
scale_err_sample_duration: Enter a sampling duration between 1 and 72 hours.
scale_err_daily_time: Enter the daily measurement time as HH:MM.
scale_confirm_samples: Delete the samples of the previous session?
scale_confirm_samples_body: Starting a session removes every sample record from the previous one. Daily records, settings and calibration are kept.
scale_err_formula: Enter a formula such as -412.5 +3.75 t -0.0625 t^2. Each coefficient must be between -1000000 and 1000000; a coefficient out of range is not saved.
scale_reason_no_load: the known weight barely changed the reading. Place the weight on the platform and try again.
scale_reason_timeout: the scale stopped sending readings. Check the HX711 wiring and try again.
scale_reason_load_changed: the load changed during averaging. Wait a moment and try again.
scale_err_no_average: The scale did not finish averaging. Check the HX711 wiring and try again.
scale_nothing_saved_noisy: Nothing was saved. If the scale was still and only noisy, raise the stability limit.
scale_err_known_weight: Enter a known weight of at least 10 g.
scale_keg_change_note: The next daily record will start a new keg.
scale_confirm_history_body: Every keg's daily level, consumption, raw counts and temperature records are removed. Settings and calibration are kept. This cannot be undone.

scale_err_history_read: Measurement finished, but the daily history could not be read.
